name: Ajay Maurya
bio: Ajay is a Senior Frontend Engineer and WordPress developer based in Mumbai, India. He works professionally as a senior developer at Fueled and has previous experience with companies like BrowserStack and 10up. He is also an active organizer in the tech community, helping run events such as WordCamp Mumbai.

name: Akshaya Rane
bio: Akshaya Rane is an Enterprise Project Manager at Multidots who believes that good project management is as much about people as it is about plans, processes, and deadlines. A WordCamp speaker and longtime WordPress contributor, she has been part of the community for over eight years —organizing the do_action event, WordPress Meetup, contributing to WordPress releases, and helping bring the WordCamp Asia 2026 Contributor Day together. Outside project plans and release schedules, you’ll often find her sharing what she’s learning about leadership, communication, and working better together.

name: Amar Sawant
bio: I’ve been actively involved in the WordPress community for several years, starting my journey by volunteering at WordCamps in Mumbai and Pune since 2016. These experiences helped me connect with inspiring people and learn from the vibrant WordPress ecosystem. In 2025, I had the opportunity to attend and sponsor WordCamp Kolhapur, as well as participate in WordCamp Pune, which further deepened my connection with the community. Along the way, I’ve also conducted a session for the WordPress Mumbai community, sharing knowledge and encouraging open discussions. Beyond events, I contribute to WordPress Marathi translations, helping make WordPress more accessible to local users. For me, WordCamps are more than just events—they’re spaces where ideas grow, friendships form, and collaboration thrives. I’m excited to bring this passion and experience to WordCamp Asia 2026 as part of the organizing team.

name: Aniket Ananda Patil
bio: Aniket Ananda Patil is an SEO professional and digital marketing specialist based in Mumbai, with experience in technical SEO, content strategy, local SEO, and organic growth. He has worked across diverse SEO projects, helping businesses strengthen their online visibility and build sustainable search performance. With a background in Information Technology and an MBA in Digital Marketing, Aniket brings together technical knowledge and marketing expertise. His work with WordPress and digital marketing has also led him to become an active member of the Mumbai WordPress community, where he enjoys learning, sharing knowledge, and connecting with fellow professionals and enthusiasts.

name: Arundhati Kane
bio: Arundhati is an experienced Psychologist, Curriculum Developer, and IB and IGCSE Cambridge Psychology Tutor with a strong interest in education, learning, and human behaviour. Her journey into the digital world began when she created her own WordPress website to build and sell her fashion jewellery brand, Itahdnura Kollection. This experience sparked her interest in website development, digital content, branding, and creating engaging online experiences. She later extended her work into Mind Mosaic, a platform that brings together her experience and interest in psychology, education, and creative learning. Through Mind Mosaic, she explores psychology in an accessible and engaging way, while developing school curriculum resources and content designed to make concepts easier to understand and apply.

name: Brijesh Kothari
bio: Brijesh Kothari is a Project Manager at Softaculous, where he has spent over 15 years growing from Marketing Executive to leading 20 people across five teams. He oversees products including Softaculous, AMPPS, SecLayer, Rebootless and Pinguzo, a cloud-based website and server monitoring platform. Starting out in marketing and support before moving into PHP development, he brings a well-rounded view of how products are built, shipped and supported. A speaker at WordCamp Kolhapur 2025, Brijesh is excited to give back to the WordPress community as part of the WordCamp Mumbai 2027 organizing team.

name: Lokesh Prem Budhrani
bio: Lokesh is a developer, contributor, an MBA and a multidimensional person who equally loves the world of Finance and Technology. He works for BDO India services private limited as an Assistant Manager in the Finance Digital Space. He loves traveling and networking with people as much as he can, and is always inquisitive to learn new things. He strongly believes that one always learn something new every day. His other interests include photography, DJing, traveling, and exploring different cuisines.

name: Rashmi Katakwar
bio: Rashmi Katakwar is a CPACC-certified freelance accessibility consultant and passionate advocate for digital inclusion. She helps clients around the world make websites, digital products, and eLearning experiences more accessible and inclusive. Rashmi is a W3C Invited Expert and contributes to the development of web accessibility standards. Her journey with the WordPress community began when she presented at WordPress Accessibility Day 2023. Since then, she has continued to contribute to the WordPress community through workshop, knowledge sharing, and accessibility advocacy. Rashmi loves exploring new places, experiencing different cultures, and discovering new cuisines.

name: Siddhesh Gupta
bio: Siddhesh Gupta is a BCA student specializing in Artificial Intelligence and a WordPress developer, project manager, and digital marketing professional based in Mumbai. He has been working with WordPress for over five years, building and managing websites and working across digital marketing, SEO, and AI-powered automations. His journey with the WordPress community includes volunteering at WordCamp Mumbai and WordCamp Asia 2026, and he is excited to continue contributing as part of the WordCamp Mumbai 2027 organizing team. He enjoys learning, experimenting with technology, building useful solutions, and connecting with people in the community.

name: Sourabh Matolia
bio: Sourabh brings over 13 years of practical experience across various roles within the WordPress and broader web development ecosystem. Currently working as a Technical Delivery Manager at MakeMeLocal, he remains highly curious and stays closely involved with the technical mechanics of the business. As a dedicated community member, Sourabh has taken on multiple responsibilities across recent WordCamps. He values straightforward, productive discussions and is always open to an interesting conversation with like-minded people.

name: Vishal S Mukadam
bio: Vishal Mukadam is a WordPress Implementor and Designer who runs WPCounty, a web agency helping individuals, small businesses, and enterprises build fast, secure, and user-friendly WordPress websites. Active in the WordPress Mumbai community since 2015, he has contributed through marketing, photography, translation, and volunteering at WordCamps and meetups across India. Passionate about Full Site Editing (FSE) and SEO, Vishal enjoys helping others unlock the power of WordPress while fostering community growth.
